_comment: Subsetted Montserrat faces for the GUI. Built by tools/build_font_subset.py into
LVGL's built-in fonts carry all of printable ASCII plus 61 FontAwesome symbols at every
enabled size, which came to 231 KB of flash -- ~20% of the 1.5 MB app partition -- to draw
digits, a colon and four compass letters. Nothing in firmware/gui uses LV_SYMBOL_*, so the
FontAwesome range is dropped outright and each size carries only the glyphs its labels can
RULE: if you give a label a new string at size N, add its characters here and rebuild, or the
glyph renders as a blank box. Sizes whose text comes from the phone (street name, ETA) must
stay full-ASCII -- we cannot know what they contain.

Size 14 is deliberately NOT subsetted: it renders the street name and ETA, which come from the phone as arbitrary text. It stays LVGL's built-in lv_font_montserrat_14, which is also LV_FONT_DEFAULT and only 8.6 KB -- subsetting it would mean shipping two 14px faces.

fonts.why: idle odometer '%lu km' (grouped by hand with commas -- '3,500 km'), dial distance '%u m', odometer tenths digit, and the compass cardinals (only N/E/S/W appear in the 16-point names).

odometer heading '%u°' / '--°' and odometer clock 'HH:MM' / '--:--'. ' apm' is insurance: view_state.h specifies a 24h clock, but the string comes from the phone and a 12h 'am/pm' would otherwise render blank.
odometer whole-km digits, set one character at a time.
idle clock 'HH:MM' / '--:--', same 12h insurance as size 28.
